name: Disco Deco
summary: Disco Deco is an aesthetic design prevalent from the mid-1960s to the 1970s and a design revival of 1920s Art Deco that is characterized by classic geometric glamour with the hedonistic, vibrant energy of the rising disco nightclub era, such as Studio 54.
description: Disco Deco is an aesthetic design prevalent from the mid-1960s to the 1970s and a design revival of 1920s Art Deco that is characterized by classic geometric glamour with the hedonistic, vibrant energy of the rising disco nightclub era, such as Studio 54. It often associates sleek symmetry with electric nightlife energy, along with this aesthetic focusing more likely on psychedelic elements but with a luxurious and disco-related appearance.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Fun, glamor
